method: anomaly_score = sum over (indicator in event_category) of direction × z_score × weight (post-#591 filter). AUC computed per event_category against y_post_cutoff with bootstrap 95% CI (1000 resamples). Stratified AUC by n_indicators_used (threshold 10). ECE computed per category and cross-category (10 bins, min-max-scaled).
method_caveats: Imbalanced ground truth bias: ground truth excludes (country, event_category) cells where the country never had ANY event of that category (pre or post cutoff). High-base-rate categories (e.g. bilateral_treaty ~0.72) suppress discrimination signal. Mean AUC is therefore a LOWER bound on per-cell predictive power.

Cross-category ECE (`ece` field, `reliability_diagram`) reflects category-base-rate mixing, NOT per-category calibration. Use `per_event_category_ece` for per-category calibration instead. Both retained: cross-category for v3 backward-compat, per-category for Phase 5+ analysis.

Bootstrap CI on per-category AUC uses percentile method (non-bias-corrected). For categories with n < 10 valid resamples the CI is reported as None — typically driven by all-same-label in many bootstrap draws when the ground-truth positive count is small, or when the underlying cell count is below the data-sufficiency floor of 5 (in which case the point-AUC is also None).

In signed-scoring mode (arms A, B), indicators with direction:0 in the catalog contribute zero to the anomaly_score. The stratified-AUC `n_indicators_used` threshold counts ALL joined indicators (including direction:0 zero-contributors), so the stratification reflects candidate-pool size, not effective-signal-pool size.

Risk-direction inversion (signed arms A, B): catalog convention is `+1 = protective`. To keep `anomaly_score` interpretable as a RISK score (HIGH → HIGH event probability — required for AUC vs y_post_cutoff comparability with the unsigned arms C, D), per-row partial scores in signed mode are negated: risk_partial = -(weight × direction × z_score). This makes signed and unsigned arm AUCs directly comparable, and makes the A-vs-D delta a directional improvement measure. See _derive_category_seed sibling for the related determinism fix.
